content: हित {%a.%} [धा-क्त, हि-क्त वा] .²1 Put, laid, placed. .²2 Held, taken. .²3 Suitable, fit, proper, good (with <ab>dat.</ab>); गोभ्यो हितं गोहितम्. .²4 Useful, advantageous. .²5 Beneficial, advantageous, wholesome, salutary (said of words, diet <ab>&c.</ab>); हितं मनोहारि च दुर्लभं वचः <ls>Ki. 1. 4</ls>, <ls n="Ki.">14. 63</ls>. .²6 Friendly, kind, affectionate, well-disposed (generally with <ab>loc.</ab>); माता मित्रं पिता चेति स्वभावात् त्रितयं हितम् <ls>H. 1. 35</ls>. .²7 Sent, impelled. .²8 Gone, proceeded. .²9 Auspicious. .{@-तः@} A friend, benefactor, friendly adviser; हितान्न यः संशृणुते स किंप्रभुः <ls>Ki. 1. 5</ls>; आपदामापतन्तीनां हितोऽप्यायाति हेतुताम् <ls>H. 1. 28</ls>. .{@-ता@} A causeway, dike; <ls>Ms. 9. 274</ls>. .²2 <ab>N.</ab> of particular veins; हिता नाम नाड्यो द्वासप्ततिसहस्राणि हृदयात् पुरीततमभिप्रतिष्ठन्ते <ls>Bṛ. Up. 2. 1. 19</ls>. .{@-तम्@} .²1 Benefit, profit or advantage. .²2 Anything proper or suitable. .²3 Well-being, welfare, good.
